evidence_items.publisher: Shakked Noy and Whitney Zhang, MIT
evidence_items.explanation: This preregistered experiment randomly exposed half of 444 professionals to ChatGPT and found faster writing with improved quality. The event date marks the public existence of this evidence, the fact tested by the evidence-existence assertion, rather than the experiment's execution date.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction, paragraph following discussion of worker attrition
evidence_items.explanation: The published study uses staggered deployment and comparison-based analysis of 5,172 support agents, finding about 15% more issues resolved per hour, with differing effects across workers. Its publication establishes that substantial workplace evidence existed before the post; it does not establish economy-wide gains.

evidence_items.locator: Employees discussion, paragraph beginning with year-end headcounts
evidence_items.explanation: The adjacent passage attributes reductions to a strategy involving AI and other efficiency measures. This is relevant evidence against the blanket replacement assertion, but headcount changes and management attribution do not independently identify which positions AI replaced.

evidence_items.locator: Opening summary; methodology and Core Result sections
evidence_items.explanation: Random assignment across 246 issues completed by 16 experienced maintainers produced a slowdown. This limits generalization from positive studies, but neither erases their existence nor tests non-technical users delivering software.

Before Zitron's post, METR had reported follow-up estimates suggesting speedup while warning that selection effects made the magnitude unreliable. The earlier slowdown should therefore not be presented as a settled description of current coding tools.

unresolved_gaps: The reviewed workforce filing does not independently separate AI-caused position replacement from other reasons for reduced headcount.
No accessible, adequately matched comparison found in this search establishes the effect of non-technical LLM coding on delivery of usable software.
The speaker supplied no threshold for compelling evidence; a narrower requirement for organization-wide or economy-wide gains would change the assessment.
